title: Chassis Standoff Electrical Short
description: An extra metal standoff left under the motherboard touches bare copper solder traces on the back of the PCB.
symptoms: PSU clicks off immediately after power button is pressed (OCP/SCP trip)
Zero fan spin or momentary flash of RGB LEDs
solution: Remove motherboard and unscrew redundant metal standoffs that do not align with motherboard mounting screw holes.

title: Unseated Memory Stick
description: One RAM stick was pushed into the slot but only one end latched, leaving pins partially disconnected.
symptoms: Continuous repeated beep code or 3 beeps
Motherboard DRAM diagnostic LED solid amber/yellow
Fans spin at 100% with no video display
solution: Release latches, remove memory module, align notch, and apply balanced pressure at both ends until audible clicks are heard.

title: Cooler Fan Plugged into SYS_FAN
description: The CPU cooler fan was connected to a chassis fan header (SYS_FAN) instead of the dedicated CPU_FAN header.
symptoms: UEFI error message on screen: 'CPU Fan Speed Error detected. Press F1 to Run SETUP'
System pauses boot sequence to prevent thermal runaway
solution: Move 4-pin PWM connector from SYS_FAN1 to the dedicated CPU_FAN header located adjacent to the CPU socket.
